title: Residual convergence criteria
interactive: convergence-criteria → thresholds per equation in equation order → q q q
notes: Verified by the working journal: `/solve/monitors/residual convergence-criteria 5e-1 1e-3 1e-3 1e-3 5e-6 q q q`. The values array is expanded with spaces; the order from CONVERGENCE_SETTINGS.md: continuity, x/y/z-velocity, energy (last value). The number of values must match the number of equations, otherwise the journal aborts. strict mode: energy 5e-6; relaxed mode: energy 5e-4.
